purpose: Test whether AdamW and Muon convert their different weight-space trajectories into different use of DenseOn's 768 embedding coordinates, while separating coordinate redundancy, harmful coordinates, and rotation-dependent artifacts.

inspiration.citation: Takeshita et al. (EMNLP 2025), Randomly Removing 50% of Dimensions in Text Embeddings has Minimal Impact on Retrieval and Classification Tasks
inspiration.adopted_idea: Measure performance after random coordinate removal and one-coordinate-at-a-time deletion; distinguish degrading from helpful dimensions.
inspiration.added_control: Repeat endpoint summaries after a shared orthogonal rotation because native embedding coordinates are not rotation invariant.

visibility_at_freeze.historical_role: exploratory method development and descriptive evidence only

inputs.provenance: Require every NPZ byte count, SHA-256, array shape, family, probe selection hash, and positive-first encoding to match its adjacent export manifest.

score_definition.similarity: Cosine similarity after deleting the declared coordinates and re-normalizing each query and document vector.
score_definition.shortlist_ndcg: With one positive at index 0 among eight fixed candidates, use 1/log2(rank+1), with rank equal to one plus the number of strictly higher-scoring negatives.
score_definition.margin: Positive cosine score minus the highest negative cosine score.
score_definition.scope_warning: The 224-query probe measures a frozen eight-document shortlist. Full-corpus claims require the separately audited BEIR outcome; shortlist dimensional metrics are candidate bridges, not retrieval outcomes.

coordinate_ablation.leave_one_coordinate_out: Delete each of 768 native coordinates independently and recompute shortlist nDCG and margin for every query.
coordinate_ablation.removal_gain: ablated metric minus full metric; positive values identify degrading coordinates and negative values identify helpful coordinates.
coordinate_ablation.cross_task_readout: For every coordinate, report the number of tasks on which removal improves the metric; do not call a coordinate universally degrading unless all 14 task means are positive.

random_removal.pairing: Use the exact same coordinate masks for every checkpoint and optimizer.
random_removal.interpretation: High retention under random deletion can reflect redundancy, distributed encoding, or cancellation between helpful and degrading coordinates. It is not sufficient evidence of ineffective dimension use.

rotation_control.scope: pretrained state and all 12 final checkpoints
rotation_control.transform: Three shared deterministic Haar-orthogonal 768-by-768 matrices generated by Gaussian QR with sign-standardized diagonals.
rotation_control.invariance_check: Full cosine scores and ranks must agree before and after rotation to 1e-6 in float64.
rotation_control.interpretation: A native-coordinate difference that disappears or changes sign under shared rotations is basis-dependent and cannot support a coordinate-free claim that one optimizer uses more dimensions.

corrected_primary_comparison.optimizer_summary: Average all four predeclared learning-rate cells within optimizer at each retained stage.
corrected_primary_comparison.uncertainty: Use common task resamples and simultaneous max-T 95% intervals for Muon minus AdamW, NorMuon minus AdamW, and NorMuon minus Muon at the final stage.
corrected_primary_comparison.multiplicity_family: Use one common-resample max-T critical value over all nine combinations of three co-primary features and three optimizer contrasts.
corrected_primary_comparison.trajectory: Report all optimizer-by-stage means for every metric without selecting a stage.
corrected_primary_comparison.claim_rule: Muon may be described as using native dimensions more constructively only if its helpful mass share and helpful participation are both higher and its degrading mass is lower than AdamW with all three simultaneous intervals excluding zero in the required directions.
corrected_primary_comparison.rotation_boundary: Even if the native-basis rule passes, use the phrase coordinate utilization unless the direction is stable across all three shared rotations.

retrieval_bridge.folds: Leave one dose index out across all optimizers, producing four folds.
retrieval_bridge.support: A feature must reduce pooled held-out RMSE for mean full-corpus BEIR nDCG@10 and improve at least three of four folds. Report every feature regardless of support.
retrieval_bridge.causal_boundary: Predictive support is a representation-to-retrieval bridge, not mediation of the optimizer effect.

figure_contract.panel_a: A trajectory map from common pretrained weights through optimizer-specific checkpoints to embedding-space dimensional metrics and full-corpus retrieval.
figure_contract.panel_b: All-rate mean random-removal curves for AdamW, Muon, and NorMuon, with the pretrained curve as reference.
figure_contract.panel_c: Optimizer-by-stage helpful share, helpful participation, and degrading mass; never show only a selected learning rate.
figure_contract.panel_d: The crossed state-by-operator result, visually separated from the observational dimension bridge.

claim_boundary: This analysis can show that optimizer trajectories redistribute coordinate-level retrieval contributions and can test whether that redistribution predicts corrected BEIR out of dose. It cannot infer semantic independence of dimensions, and native-coordinate ablations are not rotation invariant.
